q: A Markov partition for a hyperbolic map allows one to:
opts: Represent the dynamics as a subshift of finite type (SFT) via symbolic coding
Show the map is uniquely ergodic
exp: Markov partitions (Adler–Weiss, Bowen) give a symbolic representation: the dynamics on the partition elements is a subshift of finite type. This reduces hyperbolic dynamics to symbolic dynamics, enabling exact entropy calculations via Perron–Frobenius.
